_scenario: SOFT-ROCK central coefficient scenario (UCS 20 MPa reference) - client arbitration 2026-08-15 (soft-rock study, choice 2). OVERRIDES FILE: pass this dict to load_parameters(overrides=...) / the web-UI overrides body. Every value is [H] from soft-limestone literature, pending the drop-weight test (A/b), the site Bond test (Wi) and the RC.1/RC.2 vendor gradation test (n_comp, S_att). Engine DEFAULTS are unchanged (data/default_parameters.json keeps the mid-hard reference set).
_ucs_scaling_assumption: Envelope variants soft15 / soft30 (companion files soft-rock-scenario-soft15.json / soft-rock-scenario-soft30.json): each coefficient is mapped PIECEWISE-LINEARLY in UCS across the client envelope 15-30 MPa, anchored at the 20 MPa central value; the endpoints are the soft edge / hard edge of the literature range for that coefficient, clipped to the machine's declared parameter range. Softer UCS = lower Wi, higher A_j.b_j, lower RR slopes, higher S_att. [H] - no measured UCS-coefficient law exists for this deposit; the map is a documented monotone interpolation, to be replaced by the test campaign.

UCS_MPa._soft_rock_rationale: Client ruling 2026-08-15: very soft limestone, rippable, no blasting - reference 20 MPa (same value as the new data default; repeated here so the scenario is self-describing).

Wi._soft_rock_rationale: [H] Bond work-index tabulations put soft/weathered limestone at ~6-9 kWh/t (Bond 1961 tables and later compilations, soft limestone band; vs the current 12.54 kWh/t Fontaine reference for competent Belgian limestone) - central 7.5, envelope 6.0 (soft15) / 9.0 (soft30). Affects M2 power only, never the PSDs.

A_j._soft_rock_rationale: [H] JKMRC drop-weight database, soft calcite/limestone: A ~62-69 (expert book Q12 note documents calcite A 62-69) - central 65 (vs current 60). A saturates t10 at high energy; the soft range is slightly higher.

b_j._soft_rock_rationale: [H] JKMRC soft calcite/limestone b ~1.3-3.0 (expert book Q12 note; JKTech trends put SOFT limestone at A*b ~60-80 and beyond) - central 1.5 (vs current hard-side 0.80 [H]). A*b rises 48 -> 97.5: much softer impact breakage, t10 at CR.5011 v=30 goes 5.7 -> 11.1 %, RR n of the impact product drops 1.65 -> 1.35 (broader, finer product).

n._soft_rock_rationale: [H] Softer, more friable rock breaks with a BROADER fragment distribution: RR uniformity of crusher products on soft/friable limestone typically ~1.0-1.2 vs ~1.3-1.5 on competent rock (RR slope compilations for crushed aggregates). -15 % vs the 1.35 reference; x80 = gap rule unchanged, so the whole shift goes into extra fines below the gap.

n_comp._soft_rock_rationale: [H] Same physical direction for the smooth-roll compression component (finer, broader single-pass product on weak rock): 1.8 -> 1.6, inside the machine's declared 1.5-2.2 range; soft edge of the range at soft15.

S_att._soft_rock_rationale: [H] Weak rock abrades more per pass (attrition scales inversely with strength; Thiere 2020 gap/feed-dependent attrition rises on weaker stone): 0.06 -> 0.09, upper half of the declared 0.03-0.10 range (+50 %).

n_comp._soft_rock_rationale: [H] Identical to RC.1 (same smooth-roll model M7, same rock): 1.8 -> 1.6.

S_att._soft_rock_rationale: [H] As-built variant only (c1 is the default). Toothed-roll bed attrition rises on weak rock: 0.171 (Thiere refit) -> 0.22, above the book's Houben 0.206 and inside the declared 0.15-0.25 range (+29 %).
